title: Stir-Fried Chicken with Fenugreek and Algerian Spices
description: A unique fusion of Chinese and North African flavors, this dish combines the warmth of fenugreek with the bold spices of Algeria. Stir-fry chicken and vegetables in a savory sauce for a delicious and exotic meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of wholesome vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil. Add the garlic, ginger, onion, and bell pepper, and cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the fenugreek leaves, Algerian spices, soy sauce, and rice vinegar to the skillet, and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
